# Resource: yet_cloud_namespace

A group of applications: a product, a team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "yet_cloud_namespace" "shop" {
  name = "shop"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Its name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, with an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import):

```terraform
import {
  to = yet_cloud_namespace.shop
  id = "01J9Z8K3V7Q2M4N6P8R0S2T4V6"
}
```

With [`terraform import`](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import):

```shell
terraform import yet_cloud_namespace.shop 01J9Z8K3V7Q2M4N6P8R0S2T4V6
```
